propositions: Build and test a one-time operational script that strips .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical commits using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) without introducing new dependencies.

Prove on a fresh unfiltered --no-tags clone that the rewritten branch preserves all commits and merge commits with byte-identical HEAD tree after dynamic re-add, while reducing pack size to at most 150 MB.

Verify the script refuses to run on partial (blob:none) clones, asserts the target prefixes are absent or properly stripped, and leaves source branch and protected tag refs unchanged with no push operations.

The script must parse fast-export data blocks by byte length rather than line-based filtering to correctly handle commit messages beginning with M or D commands, and dynamically derive the re-add set from git ls-tree rather than hardcoded lists.
